scores.evidence: The objectives did not change, and q2, q3 (o1) and q6 (o2) keep their objectiveId and Bloom level after the option edits. Every objective still has 2 or more items, including apply-level or higher ones, and e1 and e3 remain transfer items. As before, o1 is a create objective, but only pr-checklist checks it at that level.

hook-b1 sets a concrete problem in 3 sentences (「毎回同じ手順をClaude Codeに貼り付けていませんか」), and the ungraded hook-q leads into 7-1. But hook-q mostly asks learners to recall lesson 6 (its explanation says 「（第6回）」), and the second problem in hook-b1, research output flooding the conversation, gets no prediction.

The glossary entries now end in です (「Claudeが一度に扱える情報の枠です。」), and the terms and aliases have not changed. They still match s1-defs and s3-defs (「コンテキストウィンドウ（context window）」). summary-next now names the exact next lesson, 「第8回｜フックで守らせ、MCPでつなぐ」, which matches the cc-08 draft title.

measure.mjs reports 「prose 1975 (budget 1,200–2,400) · est 17.9 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 18)」, and para-sentences reports 「0 paragraph(s) over 3 sentences」. Lint --strict gives 0 errors and 0 warnings. The code blocks are now wrapped short for mobile. To make that work, ex-description adds a new YAML notation (「長い説明文は、`>-` のあとで改行し、字下げして続けます。」). It says how to write `>-` but not what it does, and it adds to 7-2's load, while 7-1 is already at its term limit.

s2-skill still models 「何をするか」 and 「いつ使うか」 in its description, and its highlight [2–7] now covers exactly the name and the 4 description lines. ex-slash now names the action (「`/commit-message` と入力します。」), and ex-description says where the file goes (「できたフォルダに、エディターで `SKILL.md` を作ります。」). The subagent half of the practice is still not demonstrated before practice.

q3 d is now one line, 「手順：`npm test` を実行する／失敗を一覧にする／原因を調べる」, close in length to the other options, and it keeps its feedback. The 「手順：」 label slightly signals that this option holds body content. q2 can still be answered by recalling the key that s2-invoke names just before it.

The rewritten q3 d still targets the misconception that the steps belong in the description, and its feedback still fits (「手順は本文に書く内容です。説明文には、何をするスキルで、いつ使うのかを書きます。」). The other distractors and their feedback did not change.

s1-diagram (5 nodes) now uses one verb throughout (「全文を読む」「だけを読む」「本文を読む」) and keeps its caption 「スキルの本文は、使うときだけコンテキストに入る」. s4-table puts the short column first (「足すもの」 | 「きっかけ（読み込まれ方）」), which fits mobile better. Its caption still says 「きっかけが来たら足す」, though the rows now read from the tool to the trigger. The 「本文は読み込まない」 branch is still not drawn in the diagram.

pr-model is only re-wrapped: same content, and its highlight [3–6] still marks the description and 「disable-model-invocation: true」, which pr-model-lead explains. The task, the expect on every step, pr-prompt and pr-checklist did not change. pr-write still has a single hint (「7-2の `commit-message` を手本に」) before the full model answer.

summary-points comes after the exam. summary-next keeps the lesson-specific reflection (「スキルにしたい手順と、サブエージェントに任せたい調べものを1つずつ」) and names the next lesson by its exact title, 「第8回｜フックで守らせ、MCPでつなぐ」. It is followed by 6 flashcards and askTutor suggestions.

The changed blocks keep their claims: s2-skill still uses `git diff HEAD`, s3-file still has `tools: Read, Grep, Glob`, and pr-model still has `disable-model-invocation: true`. `>-` is standard YAML. The changelog says SKILL.md frontmatter is parsed as YAML (「Improved malformed `SKILL.md` YAML frontmatter handling: loads the skill body with empty metadata」). However, the saved skills.md and sub-agents.md pages show no folded-style description, so `>-` is not confirmed by an example (see niceToHave).

The diagram term drift from the last round is mostly fixed. s1-diagram now uses 「読む」 in every node, and the s3-diagram alt now matches its label (「自分のコンテキストでファイルを読んで要約し」). The new ex-description sentence uses です・ます, and lint finds no banned phrases or long sentences. The s1-diagram nodes say 「読む」 while its caption and alt say 「読み込まれる」. The ja-editor owns the wording.

The jp locale is complete, and the s3-diagram alt now matches what the diagram shows. s4-table keeps a header row (「足すもの」「きっかけ（読み込まれ方）」) with short, scannable first-column cells. The s2-legacy link text is descriptive.

niceToHave: Verification: the previous review had no mustFix items, and none are open from earlier rounds, so `resolved` is empty. All 8 changed blocks were reviewed in full, and none adds a teaching error or a regression.

s2-steps ex-description (changed): the `>-` sentence tells learners how to write it but not what it does, and it reads like a rule. A wrong indent breaks the YAML: the changelog says the skill then loads 「with empty metadata」, so the description is lost silently. Replace with 「長い説明文は、`>-` のあとで改行し、同じ幅で字下げして続けます。数行が1つの説明文になります。1行で書いてもかまいません。」, and add to ex-auto's troubleshoot 「`>-` のあとの行が、同じ幅で字下げされているかも見直します。」

factual doubt: the saved official skills.md and sub-agents.md pages (audit-pages-cc07) show only single-line `description:` values, never a folded `>-` scalar. The SKILL.md frontmatter is parsed as YAML (changelog: 「malformed `SKILL.md` YAML frontmatter handling」), so `>-` should work. Before publishing, confirm in the repro folder that `/skills` or the skill list shows the folded description of s2-skill and s3-file correctly. The agents file in s3-file has no such changelog line.

s4-table (changed): the header 「きっかけ（読み込まれ方）」 does not fit the フック row, where the brackets hold 「第8回で扱います」, not a way of loading. Change that cell to 「頼まなくても、毎回必ず実行してほしい。第8回で扱います」. The caption 「きっかけが来たら足す」 now reads against the row order (tool first). Consider the caption 「足すものと、そのきっかけ（公式の「少しずつ育てる」表と、読み込み方の表から抜粋）」.

s2-skill / pr-model filenames (changed): `commit-message/SKILL.md` and `update-readme/SKILL.md` drop `.claude/skills/`, while s3-file keeps the full `.claude/agents/researcher.md`, and e1 tests exactly this location. The full path is still in s2-terminal, ex-folder and pr-c1, so this is not misleading. If the mobile width allows, use `.claude/skills/commit-message/SKILL.md`. Otherwise add 「（`.claude/skills/` の中）」 to the s2-lead sentence that introduces the file.

s1-diagram (changed, carried over): the 「本文は読み込まない」 branch is still not drawn, and q1 tests that contrast. If the width allows, add `D -.->|それ以外| F[本文は
読まない]`.

q3 d (changed): the 「手順：」 prefix labels the option as body content, which hints at its feedback. Consider 「`npm test` を実行し、失敗を一覧にして、原因を調べる。」, which keeps the misconception (steps in the description) without the label.
q2 (carried over): the answer is still the key that s2-invoke names just before it. Consider asking which skill best fits `disable-model-invocation: true`, with deploy-prod as the answer.
hook-predict (carried over): add a prediction for the second problem in hook-b1, e.g. 「Claudeにサブエージェントで40個のファイルを読んでもらうと、メインの会話には何が残ると思いますか？」
pr-write (carried over): add a middle hint rung: 「説明文は「〜する。〜のときに使う。」の2文で、本文は①②③の番号つきの手順で書きます。」
summary: Verification round (mode verify): review-scope.mjs exited 0 with 8 of 72 parts changed (12%), so a full review was not required. There were no open must-fix items. The 8 changed blocks re-wrap code for mobile, swap the s4-table columns, tidy diagram terms and reword q3 d and ex-slash, and they add no teaching errors or regressions. Validate and lint --strict are clean, at 「prose 1975 … est 17.9 min」. The most useful optional fixes are to explain the new `>-` notation (and confirm that Claude Code reads it) and to make the フック row fit the new s4-table header.
